a: Oil has been a major part of Nigeria's export economy.
Nigeria has a growing fintech and digital payments ecosystem.
Lagos is a major African startup hub.
Music, film, and fashion are major soft-power exports.
A large Nigerian diaspora contributes remittances and culture abroad.
Education includes primary, secondary, and tertiary levels with public and private schools.
Public holidays include Independence Day and religious observances.
Urban traffic congestion is a common challenge in large cities.
Electricity supply reliability varies; backup power is common.
Mobile money and banking apps are widely used.
